title: Does the Pre-Ticket Guarantee Entry to Machu Picchu?
excerpt: No, the pre-ticket does not guarantee final entry to Machu Picchu. Entry depends on: daily availability available circuits entry schedules remaining ticket spaces The pre-ticket works as a temporary reservation You must complete the official purchase process Some visitors may not find availability View Machu Picchu Package

content_html:
Important Information

Daily tickets are limited
Demand increases significantly during high season
Some circuits may sell out quickly

Important Tip

If your trip has fixed travel dates:

booking your tickets in advance is still the safest option.
